We're also working on the autosave feature and the future roadmap![/p]

notes.title: Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith is now available on Steam Early Access
notes.content:
[h2][b]Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith is now available on Steam Early Access![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/3509d62761d7fc67bf60f3963adf094fc3ede25d.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ve been working hard to polish every part of Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith and we’ve been amazed by your support in the process. [b]And now, it’s time for you to dive into the world of dwarven blacksmithing![/b][/p][p][/p][p]In Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith, you’ll forge weapons and gear, then either you can sell them or arm heroes who will set off on quests with the tools you’ve created. Their quest might yield a new recipe for a new legendary sword or some gold coins to make ends meet.[/p][p]Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith is about management, growth, and hitting metal all day as a dwarven blacksmith. AND IT'S OUT TODAY![/p][p][/p][h2][b]What happens now?![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/9f69b9942ea536795584894fb363123ec9c5bd04.png"][/img][/p][p]Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith has leaped into the Early Access adventure. And we know that seeing the Early Access tag, it can be a bit of a dealbreaker for many gamers. [/p][p]But those who are familiar with our previous games, BBQ Simulator and Barista Simulator, will know that we’re in for the long run. [b]We’re going to keep forging, refining, and expanding until Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith becomes the ultimate dwarven blacksmithing game![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The road ahead...[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/fcb852fd932209465b1024a6f760e6e66807e5df.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The balancing and gameplay systems in Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith won’t forge themselves. So the hammer we need is your feedback.[/p][p]In between smashing metal on the anvil and cranking out weapons and horseshoes, share us your thoughts. We’ll share ours too![/p][p]Here’s what to expect in the future:[/p][list][*][p][b]Staff and Shop Expansion: [/b]You'll be able to recruit staff and expand your shop to realize your dream of having a dwarven startup in medieval times. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Shop Customization and Decoration: [/b]You might be a dwarf, but you should have an eye for finer things. Shop Customization is in the works![/p][/*][*][p][b]Seasonal Events:[/b] Seasonal events will have your smith churning out weapons like no other time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kingdom-themed Events[/b]: You'll have to change your weapon production volume when Kingdom-wide events like war and peace take place.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Gameplay Systems: [/b]We're planning to introduce new systems like automation (hiring goblins, maybe?) that will expand crafting, trading, hero recruitment, and more![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Join us![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/7fd69dabd1cf9b38c230daebb63cb89b5f8cdd04.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Join our Discord server to troubleshoot, report bugs, nudge us in the right direction, or just to have a chat! [/p][p]Join here: [b]Compact Core Games -[url="https://discord.gg/zvurwH3u"] [/url][/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/zvurwH3u"]https://discord.gg/zvurwH3u[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Grab your hammer. Stoke the forge. And let the ancestral might ring true at every hit![/p][p]Thank you![/p][p]
[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
Greetings, blacksmiths! The fires of our forge burn brighter than ever as we return with another exciting devlog for Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith.Today we're excited to showcase the significant improvements to three core mechanics that will transform how you craft legendary weapons and armors. Let's dive right into what makes crafting in Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith more immersive and satisfying than ever!

[h1]Forging: Master of the Anvil[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/709489c72184f4ae03a9344c00d7523c4d9ef567.png[/img]

The forge system has undergone a significant transformation to deliver a truly hands-on experience! Now you'll actively shape destiny with every strike of your hammer. Using sturdy pliers, you'll grip the glowing hot metal and position it precisely on the anvil. As long as the metal remains hot, powerful hammer blows will gradually transform that formless ingot into components worthy of legend.
Like any craft, there are secrets to master. Discover critical striking points that allow for faster and more efficient forging - a well-placed blow on these sweet spots will dramatically accelerate your progress. However, be warned! Repeatedly hammering the same location will weaken the metal's structural integrity. A true master blacksmith knows to vary their strikes, maintaining the perfect balance between speed and quality.
This dynamic approach transforms forging from a simple task into an engaging challenge that rewards skill and strategic thinking!

[h1]Assembly: Quality in Every Piece[/h1]

Our enhanced assembly system embraces a fundamental truth: a weapon is only as good as the sum of its parts.
With all your components ready, our improved assembly system lets you create weapons and armor with specific stats and qualities. Each piece contributes to the final item's power, with higher quality components yielding superior results. Our intuitive interface makes selecting and combining parts effortless, giving you unprecedented control over your creations. Choose the best quality components to craft the perfect weapon for any situation!

[h1]Sharpening: The Perfect Edge[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/94389671e64889c4d812cbc313486bff0b4131b4.jpg[/img]

What use is even the finest crafted blade without a proper edge? Your customers and heroes certainly aren't looking for dull showpieces! Our revamped sharpening mini-game brings more realistic and satisfying mechanics to this crucial final step.
The challenge lies in the technique - you must carefully position your blade against the grinding wheel at precisely the correct angle. Holding the blade in one position for too long or using inconsistent angles will result in subpar edges. Only through mastering this delicate dance of blade and stone will you create weapons with edges so keen they can slice through a falling leaf before it touches the ground.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue forging Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith into the ultimate blacksmithing experience!
The Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith Team

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow blacksmiths! Greetings, fellow blacksmiths! In our previous devlog, we shared our vision of expanding Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith with more RPG elements, and today, I'm thrilled to unveil one of our most significant steps in that direction - the Adventure System! This new feature transforms your role from a simple blacksmith to a master craftsman who outfits and manages heroes on their quests.

Adventures Await!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/9536dedc81fe71ce59643fb856e65ba15f559a33.gif[/img]

At the heart of our Adventure System lies the Adventure Table, a dynamic board that refreshes regularly with new opportunities for glory. Here, you'll find a variety of quests waiting to be undertaken, each with its own requirements, rewards, and challenges.  Each Adventure comes with crucial information you'll need to consider:
* Required Power Level: The strength needed for success
* Special Traits: Unique requirements that could give your heroes an edge
* Duration: How long your heroes will be away
* Rewards: The treasures and resources awaiting successful completion

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/c21fec3c5dcad826d2eb252811f4ca01136f532a.jpg[/img]

Heroes: Your Trusted Companions In Adventures

What good is a masterfully crafted sword without a hero to wield it? When you select an adventure, you'll be able to assign your heroes based on their unique traits and power levels. The system calculates a success rate based on how well your chosen team matches the adventure's requirements. A hero with the right trait might be worth their weight in gold for certain quests!

Want to know your chances? The success calculation system is transparent and intuitive:
* Meeting the power requirement gives you a solid base success rate
* Matching traits provide additional bonuses
* The right combination of heroes can guarantee success!

Adventure Outcomes
Once you've assembled your team and launched an adventure, you can track its progress in the In Progress section. Watch as the countdown timer ticks away, bringing your heroes closer to either triumph or defeat. But fear not - the rewards are worth the risk! Successful adventures yield:
* Essential crafting resources
* Gold to expand your business
* Experience for your heroes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43790166/25c40f03dad0d7963ab877f43c2cde5b69ed8904.jpg[/img]

A Living System
The Adventure System isn't just about sending heroes out and waiting for returns. It's a dynamic, evolving feature that adds depth to every aspect of Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith. Every weapon you forge, every piece of armor you craft, could be the key to success in a crucial adventure. Each successful quest not only brings valuable resources but also helps your heroes gain experience and grow stronger. As they level up, you'll unlock access to more challenging adventures with even greater rewards!

Stay tuned for new updates!
